title: Multiplicative Averages of Plancherel Random Partitions: Elliptic Functions, Phase Transitions, and Applications
summary: We consider random integer partitions $λ$ that follow the Poissonized Plancherel measure of parameter $t^2$. Using Riemann$-$Hilbert techniques, we establish the asymptotics of the multiplicative averages $$Q(t,s)=\mathbb{E} \left[ \prod_{i\geq 1} \left(1+\mathrm{e}^{η(λ_i-i+\frac{1}{2}-s)}\right)^{-1} \right] $$ for fixed $η>0$ in the regime $t\to+\infty$ and $s/t=O(1)$.
